skill.name: convex-test
skill.description: Generate deterministic Vitest tests for Convex functions with an in-memory backend.
skill.summary: Build focused Convex tests for data, authentication, errors, indexes, and scheduled work.
skill.author: get-convex

security_audit.summary: The skill is a prompt-only guide for writing Convex tests with convex-test and Vitest. No suspicious patterns or harmful intent were found in the 24-line SKILL.md.

content.value_statement: Convex applications need reliable coverage for data access, authentication, errors, and scheduled work. This skill guides you through focused Vitest tests against an in-memory backend.
actual_capabilities: Create tests for Convex queries and mutations with convex-test.
Test function arguments and return values.
Exercise authenticated and unauthenticated paths with test identities.
Seed in-memory data and verify index behavior.
Test scheduled functions and complete pending scheduled work.
Keep test scenarios deterministic without live deployments or network calls.
limitations: It does not test a live Convex deployment.
It does not replace end-to-end tests for a production client.
It does not inspect application files unless you provide relevant context.
It does not create external test infrastructure or deployment configuration.

use_cases.title: Add Backend Coverage
use_cases.description: Create focused tests for new Convex queries and mutations before merging application changes.

use_cases.title: Verify Access Rules
use_cases.description: Exercise authenticated, unauthenticated, and unauthorized paths with controlled test identities.

use_cases.title: Stabilize Scheduled Work
use_cases.description: Test scheduled functions, error paths, and indexed data access with repeatable in-memory scenarios.

prompt_templates.title: Test One Mutation
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a basic convex-test and Vitest test for my Convex mutation. Cover valid arguments, the returned value, and one seeded record.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner coverage for a single mutation

prompt_templates.title: Cover Authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Create tests for this Convex function with authenticated and unauthenticated identities. Verify the expected result and error behavior for each path.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Index Queries
prompt_templates.prompt: Build deterministic tests for this Convex query using seeded in-memory data. Check its index filtering, ordering, empty result, and returned fields.

prompt_templates.title: Test Scheduled Functions
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a complete convex-test suite for this scheduled Convex workflow. Cover setup, scheduling, pending work completion, error paths, and final database state.

output_examples.input: Test a task mutation that requires a signed-in user and rejects an empty title.
output_examples.output: A Vitest scenario seeds the user, calls the mutation with an identity, checks the created task, and verifies the validation error for an empty title.

output_examples.input: Verify that a query returns a user's completed tasks through an index.
output_examples.output: A deterministic in-memory scenario seeds completed and open tasks, runs the query, and confirms that only the matching completed tasks appear.

output_examples.input: Test a scheduled cleanup that removes expired records.
output_examples.output: The test schedules cleanup, completes pending scheduled work, and verifies that expired records are removed while current records remain.

best_practices: Use the in-memory convex-test backend instead of a live deployment.
Cover authentication, error paths, and successful paths.
Keep seeded data, identities, and time-dependent behavior deterministic.
anti_patterns: Do not test only the successful path.
Do not depend on real network calls or live deployment state.
Do not leave scheduled work unfinished when asserting final state.

faq.question: What does this skill test?
faq.answer: It guides tests for Convex functions, arguments, returns, authentication, errors, indexes, and scheduled functions.

faq.question: Which test tools does it use?
faq.answer: It uses convex-test with Vitest and an in-memory Convex backend.

faq.question: Does it require a live Convex deployment?
faq.answer: No. The workflow uses an in-memory backend and avoids live deployment dependencies.

faq.question: Can it test authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports testing authenticated and unauthenticated paths with controlled identities.

faq.question: Can it test scheduled functions?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers scheduled work and completing pending scheduled functions before assertions.

faq.question: How should tests remain reliable?
faq.answer: Seed predictable data, control identities, avoid real network calls, and keep time-dependent behavior deterministic.
